description.description: A 3D animated video showing a man with poor hygiene and the negative physical effects associated with it. In the first frame, a man with a disgusted expression looks at a swollen, red inflamed finger. The second frame shows an elderly man with gray hair and skin caked in dirt flexing his muscles while green gas and flies surround his head. The third frame shows the same dirty man lying in a pile of soil next to a shovel and a trash can. The final frame shows the man's face covered in sores and dirt as he blows smoke out of his mouth.

tweetMedia.transcription: He thought taking a bath would make him sick, so for over 60 years he refused to wash, saying the dirt kept him healthy. Instead, he left his home and dug a shallow hole to sleep in. He ate only roadkill and smoked animal poop out of a pipe. And instead of cutting his hair, he burned it over a fire. Over the years, he became the dirtiest man in the world. Until someone finally convinced him to take a bath, and he died shortly after.
